name: Outlook Work Calendar
summary: Fetch upcoming events from a published Outlook work calendar

tools.name: outlook_work_calendar_fetch
tools.description: Fetch upcoming events from the published Outlook work calendar. Uses the EWS JSON API — no authentication required. Requires the OUTLOOK_WORK_CALENDAR_URL and OUTLOOK_WORK_FOLDER_ID environment variables.

days.description: Number of days ahead to fetch (default 7)
